역대상 1:5.content: The sons of Japheth; Gomer, and Magog, and Madai, and Javan, and Tubal, and Meshech, and Tiras.

역대상 1:6.content: And the sons of Gomer; Ashchenaz, and Riphath, and Togarmah.

역대상 1:7.content: And the sons of Javan; Elishah, and Tarshish, Kittim, and Dodanim.

역대상 1:8.content: The sons of Ham; Cush, and Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.

역대상 1:9.content: And the sons of Cush; Seba, and Havilah, and Sabta, and Raamah, and Sabtecha. And the sons of Raamah; Sheba, and Dedan.

역대상 1:10.content: And Cush begat Nimrod: he began to be mighty upon the earth.

역대상 1:11.content: And Mizraim begat Ludim, and Anamim, and Lehabim, and Naphtuhim,

역대상 1:12.content: And Pathrusim, and Casluhim, (of whom came the Philistines,) and Caphthorim.

역대상 1:13.content: And Canaan begat Zidon his firstborn, and Heth,

역대상 1:14.content: The Jebusite also, and the Amorite, and the Girgashite,

역대상 1:15.content: And the Hivite, and the Arkite, and the Sinite,

역대상 1:16.content: And the Arvadite, and the Zemarite, and the Hamathite.

역대상 1:17.content: The sons of Shem; Elam, and Asshur, and Arphaxad, and Lud, and Aram, and Uz, and Hul, and Gether, and Meshech.

역대상 1:18.content: And Arphaxad begat Shelah, and Shelah begat Eber.

역대상 1:19.content: And unto Eber were born two sons: the name of the one was Peleg; because in his days the earth was divided: and his brother’s name was Joktan.

역대상 1:20.content: And Joktan begat Almodad, and Sheleph, and Hazarmaveth, and Jerah,

역대상 1:21.content: Hadoram also, and Uzal, and Diklah,

역대상 1:22.content: And Ebal, and Abimael, and Sheba,

역대상 1:23.content: And Ophir, and Havilah, and Jobab. All these were the sons of Joktan.

역대상 1:28.content: The sons of Abraham; Isaac, and Ishmael.

역대상 1:29.content: These are their generations: The firstborn of Ishmael, Nebaioth; then Kedar, and Adbeel, and Mibsam,

역대상 1:30.content: Mishma, and Dumah, Massa, Hadad, and Tema,

역대상 1:31.content: Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah. These are the sons of Ishmael.

역대상 1:32.content: Now the sons of Keturah, Abraham’s concubine: she bare Zimran, and Jokshan, and Medan, and Midian, and Ishbak, and Shuah. And the sons of Jokshan; Sheba, and Dedan.

역대상 1:33.content: And the sons of Midian; Ephah, and Epher, and Henoch, and Abida, and Eldaah. All these are the sons of Keturah.

역대상 1:34.content: And Abraham begat Isaac. The sons of Isaac; Esau and Israel.

역대상 1:35.content: The sons of Esau; Eliphaz, Reuel, and Jeush, and Jaalam, and Korah.

역대상 1:36.content: The sons of Eliphaz; Teman, and Omar, Zephi, and Gatam, Kenaz, and Timna, and Amalek.

역대상 1:37.content: The sons of Reuel; Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah.

역대상 1:38.content: And the sons of Seir; Lotan, and Shobal, and Zibeon, and Anah, and Dishon, and Ezer, and Dishan.

역대상 1:39.content: And the sons of Lotan; Hori, and Homam: and Timna was Lotan’s sister.

역대상 1:40.content: The sons of Shobal; Alian, and Manahath, and Ebal, Shephi, and Onam. And the sons of Zibeon; Aiah, and Anah.

역대상 1:41.content: The sons of Anah; Dishon. And the sons of Dishon; Amram, and Eshban, and Ithran, and Cheran.

역대상 1:42.content: The sons of Ezer; Bilhan, and Zavan, and Jakan. The sons of Dishan; Uz, and Aran.

역대상 1:43.content: Now these are the kings that reigned in the land of Edom before any king reigned over the children of Israel; Bela the son of Beor: and the name of his city was Dinhabah.

역대상 1:44.content: And when Bela was dead, Jobab the son of Zerah of Bozrah reigned in his stead.

역대상 1:45.content: And when Jobab was dead, Husham of the land of the Temanites reigned in his stead.

역대상 1:46.content: And when Husham was dead, Hadad the son of Bedad, which smote Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his stead: and the name of his city was Avith.

역대상 1:47.content: And when Hadad was dead, Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his stead.

역대상 1:48.content: And when Samlah was dead, Shaul of Rehoboth by the river reigned in his stead.

역대상 1:49.content: And when Shaul was dead, Baal–hanan the son of Achbor reigned in his stead.

역대상 1:50.content: And when Baal–hanan was dead, Hadad reigned in his stead: and the name of his city was Pai; and his wife’s name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezahab.

역대상 1:51.content: Hadad died also. And the dukes of Edom were; duke Timnah, duke Aliah, duke Jetheth,

역대상 1:52.content: Duke Aholibamah, duke Elah, duke Pinon,

역대상 1:53.content: Duke Kenaz, duke Teman, duke Mibzar,

역대상 1:54.content: Duke Magdiel, duke Iram. These are the dukes of Edom.
